title: Retention Score: Quantifying Jailbreak Risks for Vision Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything in terms of faith or religion. It measured the general robustness of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) against adversarial 'jailbreak' attacks designed to elicit toxic or harmful content.
findings: This paper does not contain findings related to religion. The analysis focuses on quantifying the jailbreak risks and robustness of various Vision-Language Models against image-based and text-based adversarial attacks in a general context.
